quotes.text: In the Commands status-filtered review queue, an earlier acceptance should hide a revision only while it remains newer than the author's latest review request. If the author requests review again, the revision returns to the queue. This recorded behavior leaves a manual Handled choice separate. Focused tests passed; current Phabricator history still needs to be checked for a live revision.
